title: Healthy Apple Nachos
summary: Classic caramel apples are the inspiration behind these healthy apple nachos. I make them with crisp apples, creamy caramel sauce, and crunchy toppings.
ingredients: 1 cup vegan caramel sauce (use as much as you prefer (you can also use your own caramel)
steps: Spread apple slices on a plate.
Sprinkle chocolate chips, peanuts, coconut and any other toppings over the top.
author: Anjali Shah
